doc: The values dcp_load's defaults held until 2026-10-23 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): the checkpoint dcp_save's four-items writes at step 100, 4 items per rank of 16, 32, 16, and 8 MiB, a 2 MiB .metadata, every rank its own shard. Placeholders, not measured: no job stands behind them (the 2026-10-01 traces behind the abstract are the three examples).
